description: Somalia - PreFlood Condition in Beletweyne (Download) is a hazard data set listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by ICPAC. This shapefile shows preFlood condition over Beletweyne district in Somalia from Landsat-8 data (21-12-2013). Source: UNOSAT. Coverage: Somalia. The portal files it under the publisher ICPAC. The portal shows 2018-05-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
